title: SQL Logical Execution Order
description: The logical order PostgreSQL evaluates a SELECT, and which aliases and aggregates each clause can or cannot reference.

root.label: Execution Order
root.detail: Logical order, not physical plan order; the planner may reorder when results are equal.

children.label: 1. FROM / JOIN
children.detail: Build the input row set; ON conditions applied here.

children.label: Can: base columns
children.detail: ON may reference columns of tables joined so far.

children.label: Can't: SELECT aliases
children.detail: Output aliases don't exist yet.

children.label: ON vs WHERE in outer
children.detail: Filter in ON keeps unmatched rows; in WHERE it removes them.

children.label: 2. WHERE
children.detail: Row-level filter before grouping.

children.label: Can: input columns
children.detail: Any column from FROM items, scalar subqueries.

children.label: Can't: aggregates
children.detail: SUM() in WHERE is an error; use HAVING.

children.label: Can't: SELECT aliases
children.detail: Repeat the expression or wrap in a subquery/CTE.

children.label: Can't: window funcs
children.detail: Filter on rank via an outer query.

children.label: 3. GROUP BY
children.detail: Collapse rows into groups.

children.label: Can: output aliases
children.detail: PostgreSQL allows SELECT aliases and ordinals here (extension).

children.label: Functional dependency
children.detail: Grouping by a PK lets you select other columns of that table.

children.label: 4. HAVING
children.detail: Filter groups using aggregates.

children.label: Can: aggregates
children.detail: HAVING COUNT(*) > 5.

children.label: Can't: SELECT aliases
children.detail: PostgreSQL rejects output aliases in HAVING.

children.label: 5. Window functions
children.detail: Computed over the grouped/filtered rows.

children.label: Can: aggregates inside
children.detail: e.g. RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(x)).

children.label: Can't be filtered here
children.detail: Use a subquery/CTE, then WHERE on result.

children.label: 6. SELECT
children.detail: Evaluate output expressions and aliases.

children.label: Aliases defined here
children.detail: Visible only to ORDER BY (and GROUP BY ext).

children.label: No lateral aliases
children.detail: An alias can't be used in the same SELECT list.

children.label: 7. DISTINCT
children.detail: Remove duplicate output rows.

children.label: DISTINCT ON
children.detail: Postgres: first row per key; needs matching ORDER BY.

children.label: 8. ORDER BY
children.detail: Sort the final rows.

children.label: Can: aliases & ordinals
children.detail: ORDER BY total DESC or ORDER BY 2.

children.label: With DISTINCT
children.detail: ORDER BY expressions must appear in select list.

children.label: NULLS FIRST/LAST
children.detail: NULLs sort last in ASC by default.

children.label: CASE in ORDER BY
children.detail: Custom sort orders.

children.label: 9. LIMIT / OFFSET
children.detail: Take a slice of the sorted result.

children.label: Needs deterministic sort
children.detail: Without a unique ORDER BY, results can vary.

children.label: FETCH ... WITH TIES
children.detail: Include rows tied with the last one.
